Say it for them today. / Save this du'a

caption:
One of the most beautiful du'as in the Qur'an is for our parents.

It's in Surah Al-Isra', ayah 24, right after the command to be kind to them.

Moments to say it:
→ after every prayer
→ whenever you think of them
→ on their hard days

Save this du'a.
